shortDescription: According to Nikkei Asia, Japanese motor maker Nidec will withdraw from production in Cambodia because of the impact of the border dispute with Thailand. The company is pulling back from the country as the dispute affects its operations.

title: Nidec To Withdraw From Cambodia Production Amid Thailand Border Dispute
